preconditions.description: The input string must have a length between 1 and 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(33 <= ord(c) <= 127 for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string must have ASCII codes between 33 and 127.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if '@' in stdin and len(stdin.split('@')) == 2 else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if the input contains exactly one '@' character, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(len(word) > 16 for word in hostname.split('.')) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if any word in the hostname exceeds 16 characters, otherwise 'NO'.
